svg.aria-label: Left: the hallway L with its inner corner x_L = (0, 0), its outer corner y_L = (1, 1), its outer walls a_L and c_L, and its inner walls b_L and d_L, whose lines are drawn dashed beyond the hallway; the open quarter-plane Q_L minus is shaded. Right: Gerver's sofa G and its supporting hallway at the angle t = 0.5, with the corresponding corners x(t) and y(t), walls a(t), b(t), c(t), d(t) and quarter-plane Q minus of t; the outer walls touch G
svg.title: Left: the hallway L with its inner corner x_L = (0, 0), its outer corner y_L = (1, 1), its outer walls a_L and c_L, and its inner walls b_L and d_L, whose lines are drawn dashed beyond the hallway; the open quarter-plane Q_L minus is shaded. Right: Gerver's sofa G and its supporting hallway at the angle t = 0.5, with the corresponding corners x(t) and y(t), walls a(t), b(t), c(t), d(t) and quarter-plane Q minus of t; the outer walls touch G
